items.situation: two students comparing notes on a pottery class at the craft center

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: Have you heard about the pottery class they added at the craft center?

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: I finished it last term. The instructor lets you keep everything you make, which is honestly why I signed up.

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: Really? Nice.

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: The clay's included in the fee, but you pay a separate firing charge for each piece you want kept.

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: Hmm, that still seems fair. Is there space left for the spring session?

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: It filled up within a week last year, so I wouldn't wait too long.

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: Good to know.

questions.stem: According to the man, what must students pay for separately?

options.A: A firing charge for each piece
options.B: The clay used in every project
options.C: A membership at the craft center

questions.explanation: 男生明确说黏土费用已含在学费里，但每件想烧制保留的作品要另付烧窑费，所以 A 正确。B 与原文相反，黏土是包含的（细节错误）。C 手工中心会员费全程没提（相关但未提及）。D 借用工具收费同样没有提到（相关但未提及）。

questions.stem: What will the woman most likely do?

options.A: Wait and join the summer session instead
options.B: Ask the instructor for a discount
options.C: Put her name down for the class soon
options.D: Borrow pottery tools from the man

questions.explanation: 男生说去年一周就报满了，建议她周五前登记，女生也觉得条件合理，所以最可能尽快报名，C 正确。A 等到夏季班正是男生劝她不要做的（被否定的选项）。B 讨价还价全程没提（无关的下一步）。D 借工具没有任何依据（无关的下一步）。

items.situation: two students swapping music recommendations after one tires of mainstream pop

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: I'm so tired of hearing the same three pop singers in every cafe on campus.

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: Then you'd probably like the folk stuff I've been streaming lately. It's nothing like what's on the radio.

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: Folk? I always thought that was all banjos and sad lyrics about the countryside.

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: Some of it is, honestly. But there's a newer group from Portland that mixes it with jazz drums.

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: Huh, really?

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: Their live session is only about twenty minutes. I'll text you the link tonight.

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: Perfect, thanks.

questions.stem: What are the speakers mainly discussing?

options.A: A concert they both attended recently
options.C: Whether folk music relies on banjos
options.D: The cost of a streaming subscription

questions.explanation: 女生厌倦了千篇一律的流行歌，男生推荐自己在听的民谣新团，整段都在围绕「找主流之外的新音乐」，B 正确。A 两人没有一起看过演出（话题错误）。C 班卓琴只是女生的一句刻板印象，是细枝末节（以偏概全）。D 订阅费用全程没谈（话题错误）。

questions.stem: What will the man most likely do next?

options.A: Buy tickets for the group's next show
options.B: Teach the woman to play the banjo
options.D: Send the woman a short recording

questions.explanation: 男生最后说今晚把那场二十分钟的现场版发给她，所以下一步是发一段短录音，D 正确。A 买演出票超出了对话内容（过度推理）。B 教弹班卓琴没有任何依据（无关的下一步）。C 退订流媒体与他的表态相反（无关的下一步）。

items.situation: two friends reworking the travel plan for a day trip after a train is cancelled

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: Did you see that the early train out to the coast got cancelled for Saturday?

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: Oh no.

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: There's still the nine-forty, but it stops at every single small station along the way.

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: So we'd lose almost two hours sitting on platforms. What about that express bus from the depot?

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: It leaves at eight and goes straight through, and the tickets are cheaper too.

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: That settles it. Let's book the bus tonight, before the weekend seats are gone.

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: Sounds good to me.

questions.stem: What is the conversation mainly about?

options.B: Deciding which coastal town to visit
options.C: Choosing another way to travel Saturday
options.D: Explaining why the early train was cancelled

questions.explanation: 早班车取消后，两人比较慢车和长途巴士，最后决定改乘巴士，整段都在重新选择交通方式，C 正确。A 票价只是顺带提了一句更便宜，不是主题（话题错误）。B 去哪个海边小镇从未讨论（话题错误）。D 取消原因对话里根本没解释，只是起因（以偏概全）。

questions.stem: What will the speakers most likely do this evening?

options.C: Postpone the trip until next weekend
options.D: Drive to the coast in a borrowed car

questions.explanation: 男生最后说趁周末座位没卖光今晚就订巴士，所以他们会在当晚订座，A 正确。B 九点四十的慢车正是两人算过会浪费两小时而放弃的（被否定的选项）。C 推迟行程没人提过（无关的下一步）。D 开车去海边完全没有依据（无关的下一步）。

items.situation: two students dividing up the shopping for a dinner party

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: Have you thought at all about what we're actually serving at Friday's dinner?

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: I was going to grab three kinds of cheese and a couple of loaves from the bakery.

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: Good call. But remember Daniel doesn't eat any dairy at all.

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: Right, I completely forgot. I'll add a big bowl of olives and some roasted peppers for him.

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: Perfect.

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: I'll handle the rest at the market tomorrow morning, so you don't have to come along.

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: I'll grab the bread on my way back from the library.

questions.stem: What does the man say he will add to the menu?

options.A: A second loaf of fresh bread

questions.explanation: 男生想起 Daniel 不吃乳制品后，说要加一大碗橄榄和烤甜椒，所以 D 正确。A 面包由女生负责，不是他额外加的（张冠李戴）。B 甜点从头到尾没提（相关但未提及）。C 加更多奶酪与照顾不吃乳制品的朋友正好相反（细节错误）。

questions.stem: What will the woman most likely do on Friday?

options.A: Call Daniel about what he eats
options.B: Stop for bread after leaving the library
options.C: Meet the man at the market
options.D: Roast the peppers in her own kitchen

questions.explanation: 女生说从图书馆回来的路上顺手买面包，所以周五她会在离开图书馆后去买面包，B 正确。A 打电话问 Daniel 没有依据，他的忌口两人已经知道（无关的下一步）。C 男生说自己明早独自去市场采买（被否定的选项）。D 烤甜椒是男生负责的部分（张冠李戴）。
